_readme: Curated per-version status shown in TrackPro's in-app Beta Channel version list (Settings). Statuses: 'recommended' | 'testing' | 'buggy'. Defaults when a version is absent here: stable releases show 'recommended', pre-releases show 'testing'. Add an entry to override — e.g. mark a beta 'buggy' the moment a field report confirms a real problem, with a short honest note. Synced to the public repo by scripts/publish-update-release.ps1 on every publish; the app fetches it raw from the public repo's main branch.
